## 2. Detailed Refinishing Services

### 2.1 Bathtub Refinishing & Reglazing (Most Popular)
- **Surfaces Restored**: Porcelain, fiberglass, cast iron, steel, enamel, acrylic, and antique clawfoot bathtubs.
- **Coating System**: Industrial epoxy primer followed by high-gloss, chemical- and stain-resistant Acrylic Polyurethane Enamel.
- **Repairs Included**: Fixes chips, cracks, holes, rust spots, spiderwebbing, dull/porous glaze, and hard-water stains.
- **Safety Add-On**: Optional slip-resistant (non-skid) textured bottom application available.
- **Completion Time**: 2 to 4 hours on-site; ready for normal use after a 24-hour cure.

### 2.2 Shower Refinishing & Resurfacing
- **Surfaces Restored**: Fiberglass shower stalls, acrylic shower enclosures, shower pans/bases, and tiled shower walls.
- **Benefits**: Eliminates stubborn stains, hard-water buildup, chips, and floor cracks; coating meets or exceeds original manufacturer specifications for stain and acid resistance.

### 2.3 Ceramic & Porcelain Tile Refinishing
- **Surfaces Restored**: Bathroom wall tile, shower surround tile, tub surround tile, and floor tile.
- **Process**: Deep chemical cleaning, grout repair and sealing, bonding primer, and high-gloss glaze coat that seals grout lines so they never need scrubbing or regrouting again.

### 2.4 Countertop Refinishing (Multi-Stone Finish)
- **Surfaces Restored**: Bathroom vanities and kitchen countertops made of Formica, laminate, cultured marble, or ceramic tile.
- **Coating System**: Multi-Stone architectural coatings that deliver the look and texture of natural granite or stone in dozens of designer colors at a fraction of stone replacement cost.

### 2.5 Bathroom & Kitchen Cabinet Refinishing
- **Surfaces Restored**: Bathroom vanities and kitchen cabinets.
- **Benefits**: Factory-smooth finish in modern colors without tearing out cabinet boxes or disturbing plumbing and countertops.

### 2.6 Sink Refinishing & Restoration
- **Surfaces Restored**: Porcelain, cast iron, fiberglass, and cultured marble bathroom and kitchen sinks (including integrated vanity tops).
- **Repairs**: Repairs chips, rust rings around drains, cracks, and worn glaze.

### 2.7 Residential & Commercial Refinishing
- **Residential**: Single-family homes, townhomes, condominiums, and coastal vacation rentals across Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, and Sarasota.
- **Commercial**: Hotels, beach resorts, apartment communities, student housing, senior living facilities, hospitals, and property management portfolios. Flexible multi-unit scheduling and volume pricing.

---

## 3. Our 4-Step Professional Restoration Process
1. **Step 01 — Industrial Clean & Etch**: Complete removal of soap scum, mineral deposits, oils, and old caulk, followed by surface etching and precision repair of any chips, cracks, holes, or rust.
2. **Step 02 — Epoxy Primer**: Application of a specialized industrial bonding epoxy primer engineered for maximum molecular adhesion to porcelain, fiberglass, metal, or tile.
3. **Step 03 — Acrylic Polyurethane Topcoat**: Fine-finish HVLP spray application of multiple coats of ISO-FREE Acrylic Polyurethane Enamel (or Multi-Stone countertop coating) for a mirror-smooth, factory-new finish.
4. **Step 04 — 24-Hour Cure**: Surface cures in 24 hours so the homeowner or guest can use their newly restored bathroom the very next day.

| Category | Bath Professional Refinishing (Winner) | Traditional Replacement / Remodeling |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cost** | **Save over 80%** compared to replacement | Full fixture, plumbing, tile & labor replacement cost |
| **Time Required** | **2–4 hours** (done in 1 day) | 1 to 3 weeks of construction |
| **Demolition** | **Zero tear-out** | Rip out tub, surrounding tile, drywall & flooring |
| **Mess & Debris** | Minimal dust; full masking & fume extraction | Heavy construction zone & dumpster debris |
| **Bathroom Downtime** | **Ready to use in 24 hours** | Weeks without a working bath or shower |
| **Keep Existing Tile/Plumbing** | Tile and plumbing stay intact | Usually demolished during tub removal |
| **Color Options** | Any standard or custom color match | Limited to in-stock replacement fixtures |
| **Environmental Impact** | Nothing sent to the landfill | Old tub and tile hauled to landfill |

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Do you only restore bathtubs?
**A:** No, we also restore sinks, tile, countertops, showers, cabinets, grout, and more.

### Q: What types of surfaces do you restore?
**A:** Porcelain, fiberglass, cast iron, acrylic, Formica counters, ceramic tile, and cultured marble. If you have any other surface, call (813) 445-9319 or email support@bathprofessional.com.

### Q: How long does the bathtub restoration process take?
**A:** Approximately 2 to 4 hours depending on the condition of the bathtub and prep work required. More damaged tubs with chips, cracks, or holes require slightly more prep time.

### Q: What types of bathtub repairs can you do?
**A:** All kinds—we repair chips, holes, cracks, rust spots, fiberglass bottom cracks, and peeling prior coatings.

### Q: How long does the curing/drying process take?
**A:** After we restore/refinish your bathtub or other surface, wait 24 hours for the surface to cure/dry before using it again.

### Q: What colors do you offer to refinish bathtubs and tile?
**A:** We offer any color. Most customers choose standard colors like China White, Pure White, Kohler White, Biscuit, Bone, or Almond, and we can custom-match any color you choose.

### Q: What coatings do you use for countertops?
**A:** We use Multi-Stone coatings for countertop restorations, giving countertops a durable stone-type finish in a wide variety of colors.

### Q: Is there a warranty for the bathtub and other surfaces restored?
**A:** Yes. Our work is guaranteed for 5 years against any failure of adhesion to the surface, and a care sheet is provided on completion of every job. We also offer an optional Lifetime Warranty for as long as you own the property against chipping or peeling.

### Q: Can you add a non-skid component to my bathtub?
**A:** Yes, we can easily add a slip-resistant non-skid texture to the bottom of the bathtub during refinishing.

### Q: What is the best way to clean a refinished surface?
**A:** Do not use abrasive cleaners or bleach pads. Clean with mild, natural, non-abrasive liquid cleaners; the fewer harsh chemicals used, the longer the finish will last.
